sec.p: A driving simulator helps everyone: from Leclerc in F1 to your 50-year-old aunt who has finally signed up for her driving licence. But never as much as it helps Waymo. And autonomous driving.
Using language models like ChatGPT, we can create “agents”: impersonations of business or social roles that, by interacting, create virtual societies, like in The Sims or an episode of Doctor House.
